channel.title: Model Guide — price and model changes
channel.description: Launches, price cuts, promos and scheduled price changes for AI models (Claude, GPT, Gemini, Grok, open-weight).

item.title: Zen free list reshuffled (OpenCode Zen)
item.description:
Oct 26, 2026 · OpenCode Zen

DeepSeek V4 Flash deprecated on Zen. Free now: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, GLM-5.3-Flash, MiMo V2.6 Flash, NVIDIA Nemotron trio, Beam, Flint 40B, Big Pickle. MiMo v2.5, North Mini Code, Hy3 no longer free.

item.title: V4.1 Flash · peak pricing live · V4 Pro price up (DeepSeek)
item.description:
~Oct 17, 2026 · DeepSeek

V4.1 Flash $0.30/$1.20 peak, $0.15/$0.60 off-peak (V4 Flash retired; its ID routes here). Peak hours 01:00–04:00 & 06:00–10:00 UTC Mon–Fri. V4 Pro now $1.32/$3.96 peak, $0.66/$1.98 off-peak (was $0.435/$0.87).

item.title: Sonnet 5 $2/$10 made permanent (Anthropic)
item.description:
Aug 10, 2026 · Anthropic

Scheduled Sep 1 increase to $3/$15 cancelled. $2/$10 is now the standard price. Biggest pricing surprise of the month.

item.title: V4 Flash 0731 public beta (DeepSeek)
item.description:
Jul 31, 2026 · DeepSeek

Price unchanged $0.14/$0.28 — but DeepSWE jumped 7.3% → 54.4% (7×). V4 Pro confirmed at $0.435/$0.87. Legacy deepseek-chat / deepseek-reasoner aliases retired. Future 2× peak-hour pricing announced (Beijing 09:00–12:00 & 14:00–18:00), effective date TBA.

item.title: GPT-5.6 price cuts (OpenAI)
item.description:
Jul 30, 2026 · OpenAI

Luna −80%: $1/$6 → $0.20/$1.20 · Terra −20%: $2.50/$15 → $2/$12 · Sol unchanged at $5/$30. Priority Processing renamed Fast mode (2× price, 2.5× speed). Both cuts apply retroactively to usage from Jul 30.

item.title: Opus 5 launch (Anthropic)
item.description:
Jul 24, 2026 · Anthropic

$5/$25 — same price as Opus 4.8, massively better. Opus 4.8 is now superseded (keep only if Opus 5's safety classifier blocks a request).
